ingredients.title: Shortbread truffle layer
items: 1 box (10 oz) Lorna Doone's shortbread cookies

instructions.title: Brownies
items: Cream butter and sugar together in a large mixing bowl. Add vanilla and eggs and mix well.
Add salt, cocoa powder and flour and stir to well combine. Do not over mix.
Pour into a greased 9x13-inch pan. Bake at 350°F for 22-25 minutes.

instructions.title: Shortbread truffle layer
items: Place cookies in a food processor until fine powder.
Mash in cream cheese and sugar until mixture is well combined.
Gently press shortbread truffle evenly over cooled brownies.

instructions.title: Caramel layer
items: Place caramel cubes and milk in a medium microwave-safe bowl.
Microwave in 30-second increments until melted, stirring in between each increment until melted and smooth.
Evenly pour over shortbread truffle layer. Place in fridge to let it cool.

instructions.title: Chocolate layer
items: Combine chocolate chips and shortening together in a medium microwave-safe bowl.
Microwave in 30-second increments, stirring in between each increment until melted and smooth.
Evenly spread over the top of cooled caramel layer. Let set up in fridge before cutting into.
